COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
BA2 No.37 of 2021
Hon'ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Avidit Noliyal, learned counsel for the
applicant.
 Mrs. Pushpa Bhatt, learned Dy.A.G. along
with Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, learned B.H. for the
State.
Accused-Satendra @ Sachin has sought his
release on bail in connection with Case Crime/FIR
No.151 of 2018, u/s 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B
IPC, at P.S. Rajpur, Distt. Dehradun.
It is argued that the accused has been falsely
implicated; he is languishing in jail since
07.02.2019; the co-accused Ram Bharose and Sweti
Srivastava have been enlarged on bail. Thus, he is
entitled for bail; and he may be granted bail on the
ground of parity.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State
opposed for bail.
The accused involved in the Crime No.151 of
2018 and also in Crime No.522 of 2018; the
accused was arrested on 03.02.2019, after that from
his possession forged pass-books, cheque-books,
ATM Cards, Adhar Cards and other forged papers
were recovered; CCTV footage was also collected
by the police, where one male and one female were
seen entering into the Bank and depositing the
cheques; accordingly, an amount of Rs.4,96,900/-
was withdrawn from the account of Kamal Bairat

and an amount of Rs.5,15,985/- was also withdrawn
from the account of Smt. Mala Tyagi; although, the
above co-accused have been granted bail, but the
role assigned to the present accused is different
from the above co-accused; therefore, looking to the
gravity of offence, it is not a fit case for bail at this
stage.
The bail application is thus, dismissed.
Pending application, if any, stands disposed
of.
